about: Gates the release evidence report looks up for a release of this repository (release-evidence.mjs). A gate is decided by the newest completed run at the release commit, else on the release-candidate branches.

gates.label: CI: corpus generators, package tests, model-to-code smoke
Cross-language gate (9 languages over the conformance corpus)
Verified core: Dafny proofs, generated-JS reproducibility, differentials, diverse compilation
Formal proofs (Dafny, TLA+, Lean, Verus, EasyCrypt, trusted base)

known_exceptions: Packages and features in the experimental maturity tier are published for evaluation; the commitments of the stable and production tiers do not apply to them (https://github.com/Atlas-Authorization/pca/blob/main/docs/maturity.md).

PCA Core (@atlasauth/pca/core) still loads 24 experimental modules at run time through the core action verifier (intent layer, attestation, liveness beacons, transparency ledger); the list may only shrink (https://github.com/Atlas-Authorization/pca/blob/main/docs/maturity.md).
